text: {"claims": [{"quote": "Revenue rose 3.9% to about $648 billion, up from $605 billion in FY2023.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "Net income increased to about $7.2 billion from $5.8 billion in FY2023,", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "while diluted EPS was about $2.65 versus $2.04 in FY2023.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "Gross margin remained under pressure, around 32.5%,", "verdict": "unchecked"}, {"quote": "net margin about 1.1%,", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "though Walmart's operating margin improved.", "verdict": "unchecked"}, {"quote": "Comparable sales grew 2.4% in FY2024, versus 7.3% in FY2023 and 6.7% in FY2022.", "verdict": "unchecked"}, {"quote": "Revenue growth was slower in FY2024 but still positive; FY2023 revenue was up 5.7% from $572 billion in FY2022.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "Cash flow remained strong, with operating cash flow around $36 billion in FY2024 and free cash flow above $20 billion after capex.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "The prior fiscal years showed recovery from pandemic-era demand: FY2021 revenue $480 billion, net income $6.7 billion, EPS $2.28; FY2020 revenue $432 billion, net income $4.1 billion, EPS $1.88.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "The business kept gaining market share and controlling costs, but margin recovery was gradual.", "verdict": "unchecked"}], "action": "block"}
